Check the inputs of the KL calibration

Source: R/npp_kl_calibration.R
npp_kl_validate_inputs.Rd

Every one of these makes the calibration criterion undefined rather than merely inaccurate, so they are all rejected before any quadrature rule is built. Each message names the offending input and its value: the calibration runs once per scenario, deep inside a simulation, and a bare "invalid argument" there is expensive to trace back.

Usage

npp_kl_validate_inputs(
  theta_source,
  se_source,
  se_target_expected,
  theta_null,
  benefit_sign,
  d_mtd,
  lambda_kl,
  c_target,
  beta_parameter_bounds
)

Arguments

theta_source

Source treatment effect estimate.

se_source

Standard error of the source estimate.

se_target_expected

Expected standard error of the target estimate.

theta_null

Boundary of the null hypothesis space.

benefit_sign

Either 1 or -1.

d_mtd

Maximum tolerable discrepancy.

lambda_kl

Weight on the compatible term.

c_target

Shape of the two reference Beta distributions.

beta_parameter_bounds

Bounds on the calibrated shape parameters.

Value

NULL, invisibly.
